title: 第25章 兑换天材地宝修为突进第26章 明礼扇赵衡
slug: 人在镇魔司红词加身只杀不渡
lines: 当陆渊等人回到赤霞县驻所，镇魔司衙役也到了战场。
当他们看到山脚下如同尸山血海的场面之后，一个个忍不住脸色发白。
血腥场面他们见过不少，但都是那些妖魔邪祟的手笔。
可怎么这陆大人来了赤霞县之后，每每出手就是血流成河？
这是不是太凶残了点？
不过转念一想杀的都是邪教妖人，也就无所谓了。
凶残的杀戮，亮眼的战绩，等赤霞县的一系列事迹发酵出去，陆渊之名必定会响彻青州。
第二天下午，陆渊、苏定安等人回到了青州镇魔司。
司务堂，差事房内。
书吏老刘接过卷宗，看过了其中记载的事迹，狠狠地搓了一把脸。
这是交差的卷宗？
他差点以为是谁把履历表交上来了。
深吸一口气，老刘露出恭维笑容。
“杀血妖，灭尸魔，连长生教在赤霞县的分舵主阎九渊也被陆大人灭了。”
“您这一趟出去两天，可抵得上寻常人两年的功绩了。”
“您稍等，虽说您没领那尸魔和阎九渊的差事，但只需在这里补一个章程，就能多领两份功绩。”
陆渊立刻道了声谢，顺嘴又给苏定安也落了两份协办的功绩。
毕竟人家跟着跑前跑后一口一个陆大人叫着，的确没少出力。
如果不是前期工作做得好，他斩妖除魔也不会这么顺。
一文一武相辅相成，这份好处人家受之无愧。
不多时，老刘的声音在陆渊耳边响起。
“击杀初境血妖一只，凡境血奴八十七只，功绩一百三十点；”
“击杀玄境尸魔一只，凡境尸傀三十七只，功绩三百六十点；”
“击杀长生教副坛主刘韫、柳青丝，分舵主阎九渊，及三十二名教徒，功绩五百一十五点。”
“陆大人，您本次办差共获得一千零五点功绩，已经登记入册。”
“凭腰牌可入珍宝阁兑换资源，或是往精武阁兑换功法武学。”
陆渊暂时还不缺功法，倒是对珍宝阁更感兴趣。
珍宝阁是一栋三层阁楼，朱红门柱，铜钉大门。
将腰牌递给两个值守的内卫，一人看过之后，连忙将腰牌递还。
“大人请进！”
一楼摆满了紫檀木架，每一个架子上都摆满了大大小小的玉匣、瓷瓶、木盒。
有符箓，有丹药，有法器，各类天材地宝。
每个盒子前都挂着一块小木牌，上面写着名称和兑换功绩点数。
content_en:
When Lu Yuan and others returned to the Chixia County garrison, the officials of the Zhenmo Division also arrived at the battlefield.
When they saw the scene at the foot of the mountain that was like a mountain of corpses and a sea of ​​blood, they all couldn't help but turn pale.
They had seen many bloody scenes, but they were all the work of evil spirits.
But why does Lord Lu always bleed like a river of blood after coming to Chixia County?
Isn't this a bit too cruel?
But then I thought about killing all the evil spirits, so it didn't matter.
Brutal killings, brilliant achievements, and when a series of deeds in Chixia County are revealed, Lu Yuan's name will surely resound throughout Qingzhou.
In the afternoon of the next day, Lu Yuan, Su Ding'an and others returned to Qingzhou Demon Suppression Division.
Si Wu Hall, inside the errand room.
Old Liu, the scribe, took the file, read the deeds recorded in it, and rubbed his face fiercely.
Is this a submission file?
He almost thought someone had handed in the resume.
Taking a deep breath, Lao Liu showed a flattering smile.
"Kill the blood demon, destroy the corpse demon, even Yan Jiuyuan, the branch leader of the Immortality Sect in Chixia County, was destroyed by Mr. Lu."
"You have been out for two days, which is equivalent to two years of achievements for ordinary people."
"Wait a moment. Although you didn't receive the errand from the corpse demon and Yan Jiuyuan, you only need to make up a charter here to receive two more achievements."
Lu Yuan immediately thanked him and gave Su Ding'an two co-organizer credits.
After all, they were running around shouting Mr. Lu, and they were indeed putting in a lot of effort.
If he hadn't done a good job in the preliminary work, he wouldn't have been able to slay demons so smoothly.
Culture and military complement each other, and everyone deserves this benefit.
Not long after, Lao Liu's voice sounded in Lu Yuan's ears.
"Killed one first-level blood demon and eighty-seven mortal-level blood slaves, achieving 130 merit points;"
"Kill one Xuan Realm Corpse Demon and thirty-seven Mortal Realm Corpse Demons, achieving 360 merit points;"
"Killing the deputy altar leaders Liu Yun and Liu Qingsi of the Immortality Sect, the sub-ruler Yan Jiuyuan, and thirty-two followers, the merit is 515 points."
"Master Lu, you have obtained a total of 1,050 merit points on this mission and have been registered."
"With the waist card, you can go to the Treasure Pavilion to exchange for resources, or go to the Jingwu Pavilion to exchange for skills and martial arts."
...
Lu Yuan is not short of skills for the time being, but he is more interested in Zhenbao Pavilion.
Zhenbao Pavilion is a three-story attic with vermilion door pillars and copper-nailed door.
He handed the waist card to the two inner guards on duty. After one of them saw it, he quickly handed it back.
"Sir, please come in!"
The first floor is filled with rosewood shelves, and each shelf is filled with large and small jade boxes, porcelain vases, and wooden boxes.
There are talismans, elixirs, magic weapons, and all kinds of heavenly materials and earthly treasures.
There is a small wooden sign hanging in front of each box with the name and the number of merit points redeemable on it.
